value.syntax: # [doc = " The three forms of `occur`."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) enum OccurKind { # [doc = " `[uint] \"*\" [uint]`: bounded below, above, both, or neither."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " A bare `*` is this variant with both bounds absent. The ABNF admits"] # [doc = " no space anywhere inside the production, so `2 * 3` is not one"] # [doc = " occurrence indicator."] Bounded { # [doc = " The lower bound, when written."] min : Option < Uint > , # [doc = " The upper bound, when written."] max : Option < Uint > , } , # [doc = " `+`: one or more."] OneOrMore , # [doc = " `?`: zero or one."] Optional , }
